content.text: The Astros look to win their second straight game when they host the Angels on Sunday afternoon The Houston Astros host the Los Angeles Angels in the fourth and final game of their series on Sunday afternoon. The Astros got their first win of the season on Saturday when they beat the Angels 11-9. The win snapped a two-game series, and Sunday, they can salvage a split of the four-game series with the Angels. They will turn to Tatsuya Imai on the mound in the final game of the series. Imai will be making his MLB debut after signing with the Astros in the offseason. Imai has been pitching in Japan with the Saitama Seibu Lions since 2018 and was a three-time NPB all-star.
